A striking view of the 87,000 Freemasons who assembled for luncheon yesterday (AUGUST 8th) at Olympia, where the Duke of Connaught presided. There were five miles of tables, and I,300 waitresses were needed to look after this party. It is claimed that it was the world's record banquet.
